title: Fortune Sniper
description: Changes texture of fortune books so u can be rich $$$
body:
📘 Red Fortune Book (Improved Visibility for Trading)
This small texture pack changes the appearance of the enchanted book with Fortune — now featuring a bold red cover with a striking black X. It’s designed to make the Fortune book instantly recognizable while cycling through villager trades.

If you're using mods like Easy Villagers, where speed and efficiency matter, this tweak helps you quickly spot the Fortune book without having to read item names every time.

🎯 High visual contrast — instantly recognize Fortune

🧠 Made for convenience — helpful for both new and experienced players

🔄 Plug-and-play — fully compatible with other resource packs

⚠️ Requires OptiFine – this texture pack uses Custom Item Textures (CIT), which are only supported when OptiFine is installed.

This pack doesn't modify any other textures and works smoothly alongside most mods and resource packs that don't affect the Fortune book.

💬 Got feedback? Let me know! A small detail like this can make your gameplay more streamlined and enjoyable.
